title: Update /api/analyze endpoint to accept tenant context and resume_id
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/tenant/analyze accepts { resume_id, section } instead of old single-user params
Endpoint looks up resume by resume_id scoped to current tenant (404 if not found)
Analysis results stored to analyses table on completion
Response returns analysis result with cache hit/miss indicator
Error responses include appropriate HTTP status codes (400, 404, 429, 500)
